approval.comment_body_sha256_method: sha256 of the body bytes that the GitHub API returns for the comment
approval.comment_note: The comment ends with a Mergify queue command after the acceptance text.

hosted_evidence.note: The Slashing test suite run is the first full run of check-casper-soak-bindings.sh with the claims suite pinned to 4 tests.

accepted_scope.auditor: check-casper-claims.rs reads a ledger with several records as a named collection, selects the record of the audited claim, and fails closed on any other layout.
accepted_scope.test: named_claim_ledgers_select_only_the_audited_claim covers the selection and the failure cases.
accepted_scope.binding_pin: check-casper-soak-bindings.sh pins the claims suite to 4 tests, and a mismatch names the suite and both result lines.
accepted_scope.inventories: The four artifacts with two independent claims use R8 named claims in their routed Casper ledgers. Each record keeps its status, claim, evidence, and waiver.
accepted_scope.excluded: Node correctness, the profile claims, the claims that list these artifacts without a record, and a live soak result.
